author: gravitty99
name: black-and-white-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Warp stripes style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#101010, #F5F5F5, #B0B0B0, #3A3A3A). Features: film grain, cursor-reactive (repel). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
